items.ti: Dan Sullivan 상원의원은 알래스카 주를 대표하여 훌륭한 일을 하고 있습니다! 매우 뛰어나고 존경받는 상원의원이 되기 전에 Dan은 주 법무장관 및 알래스카 천연자원부 국장을 역임했습니다. Dan은 훌륭한 사람이고 항상 알래스카를 위해 일해 왔으며(2016년, 2020년, 2024년에 큰 마진으로 세 번 승리했습니다!) 미국 상원에서도 계속 그렇게 할 것입니다. 40년 만에 최초로 구입한 선박인 Arctic Security Cutter 쇄빙선 11척을 확보하는 등 알래스카를 위해 "TRUMP"보다 더 많은 일을 한 사람은 없으며 Dan Sullivan은 줄곧 우리와 함께했습니다. 그는 휘발유, 석유 및 모든 형태의 가격을 유지하는 데 도움을 줌으로써 경제 성장, 세금 인하, 규제 인하, 매우 안전한(기록 설정!) 국경 보안 유지, 놀라운 군대/재향 군인 옹호, 미국 에너지 지배력 향상을 위해 열심히 싸우고 있습니다.
items.ti_en: Senator Dan Sullivan is doing a fantastic job representing the Great State of Alaska! Prior to becoming a very distinguished and Highly Respected Senator, Dan served as State Attorney General and the Commissioner of the Alaska Department of Natural Resources. Dan is a GREAT man, has ALWAYS delivered for Alaska (which I won three times by BIG margins in 2016, 2020, and 2024!), and will continue doing so in the U.S. Senate. No one has done more for Alaska than “TRUMP,” including just securing 11 new Arctic Security Cutter Icebreakers, the first such ships bought in more than 40 years, and Dan Sullivan has been with us all the way. He is fighting hard to Grow our Economy, Lower Taxes, Cut Regulations, Help Secure our VERY Secure (Record Setting!) Border, Champion our Incredible Military/Veterans, Advance American Energy DOMINANCE by helping to keep the price of Gasoline, Oil, and all forms of Energy VERY LOW, and Defend our always under siege Second Amendment. Because of the trickery in the Voting, the Crooked, Radical Left Dumocrats have put up another man named “Dan Sullivan,” and they did this to take Votes away from our Great Senator of the same name. Democrats are trying to “trick” Alaskans, and treat Alaskan Voters with contempt. On Tuesday, August 18th, Alaskans, don’t be fooled. The Senator you want to vote for is: “SULLIVAN, DAN S. — REGISTERED REPUBLICAN/INCUMBENT” “SULLIVAN, DAN S” has my Complete and Total Endorsement for Re-Election – HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 한때 훌륭했던 뉴욕주의 차기 법무장관으로 출마한 미국 최초의 애국자인 Saritha Komatireddy를 지지하게 된 것은 큰 영광입니다. 캐시 호철(Kathy Hochul)과 미국에서 가장 부패한 법무장관 레티티아 제임스(Letitia James) 사이에, 그것은 지옥으로 사라졌습니다! Saritha는 내 친구이자 공화당 주지사 후보인 Bruce Blakeman을 포함하여 뉴욕의 가장 위대한 MAGA 전사들의 강력한 지지를 받고 있습니다! 전직 연방 검사, 마약단속국 참모총장, 당시 Brett Kavanaugh 판사의 법률 서기, 명예로운 Harvard Law School 졸업생으로서 Saritha는 자신이 뉴욕시와 주의 놀라운 사람들에게 강력한 결과를 제공할 수 있는 용기와 지혜가 있음을 입증했습니다. 그녀의 상대인 완전히 부패하고 불법적이며 무능한 Letitia "Peekaboo" James는 많은 사람들에게 우리나라 최악의 법무장관으로 간주됩니다.
items.ti_en: It is my Great Honor to endorse America First Patriot, Saritha Komatireddy, who is running to be the next Attorney General of the once wonderful State of New York. Between Kathy Hochul and the Most Corrupt Attorney General in the Country, Letitia James, it has gone to HELL! Saritha is strongly supported by the Greatest MAGA Warriors in New York, including my friend, and Republican Nominee for Governor, Bruce Blakeman! As a former Federal Prosecutor, Chief of Staff of the Drug Enforcement Administration, Law Clerk for then-Judge Brett Kavanaugh, and a distinguished Harvard Law School graduate, with Honors, Saritha has proven she has the Courage and Wisdom to deliver strong results for the incredible people of New York City and State. Her opponent, the totally corrupt, unlawful, and incompetent, Letitia “Peekaboo” James, is considered by many to be the WORST Attorney General in our Country. She is a Complete and Total Disaster, who tried running against Kathy Hochul for Governor, and got less than 1% of the Vote in the Polls, and QUIT, taking many innocent suckers down with her. She then went back to her WITCH HUNT against your favorite President, (ME!), and others, yet Murder and other Violent Crime is RAGING OUT OF CONTROL in New York, as People and Businesses flee, in Record Numbers, to other States! On the other hand, as your next Attorney General, Saritha Komatireddy will fight tirelessly to Ensure LAW AND ORDER, Grow our Economy, Champion our Law Enforcement and First Responders, Support our Military/Veterans, Advance Election Integrity, Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Uphold our Constitution, and Defend our always under siege Second Amendment. Vote against the Most Corrupt Attorney General in the Country, Peekaboo James — Vote for Saritha Komatireddy, who has my Complete and Total Endorsement to be the next Attorney General of New York. SHE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN! President DONALD J. TRUMP
